name: Project List Grid Flip
description: Dark portfolio showcase with a giant letter-reveal wordmark, a project list that flips into an image grid, hover image popup, Lenis smooth scrolling and a scroll-revealed footer wordmark.
contents: Oversized wordmark with per-letter clip reveal
Section heading with count and list/grid toggle
Project rows with title, year and image
Full-screen hover popup showing the project image
Footer with two-line tagline and repeated wordmark
behavior: Smooth scrolling through Lenis, disabled for reduced motion
Items fade in with stagger on load
Toggle between list and grid animates with GSAP Flip and image clip-path wipes
Hovering a row wipes a color fill and shows a fullscreen image popup
Footer lines and wordmark reveal on scroll
Grid collapses from 5 to 3, 2 and 1 columns on smaller screens
editableByProps: Projects, wordmark, headings, toggle labels and footer text
Background, text, wipe, border, footer and popup colors as Tailwind classes
Font family and font file URLs

needsCodeEdit.where: grid-cols-5 class string on the containerRef div
new Lenis options inside the gsap.context block

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Registers a GSAP ticker and ScrollTrigger instances, cleaned up on unmount
Hover popup is a fixed fullscreen overlay
Includes a min-h-screen list area and bottom margin that give the footer scroll room
Hover popup is hover-driven and does not show on touch devices
